inputPlan.baselinePlan: eight actual motor plans; paired levels share opponent RNG seed, not only a seed replay
inputPlan.units: standard seconds; hand m; hand tracking speed m/physics second; degrees

controller: 60 Hz scripted main-order inputs + engine-truth geometry/window observer; normal opponent AI

conditions.conditionalInitialDistanceDefinition: requestedGap + 0.9m approach space; no distance clamping

validity.inputInterface: 60Hz main-frame consumed hand deltas/taps/stick/guard; not DOM tap classification or visible-cue response
validity.attemptedDefinition: intended tap/swipe, circle begin, or new guard+forward press; direct mode counts direct requests
validity.requestAttemptedDefinition: actual secret execution request, including disabled control requests
validity.actualStartedDefinition: first actual Skill.updateSecret callback for the accepted run; counted once per run
validity.damageScope: entire preparation through observation; attack-only events retain timestamps
